notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign for Legends of Castile Enters Final 48 Hours
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there, adventure fans![/h1]

The end of the crowdfunding campaign is here, and today marks the start of the final 48 hours for Legends of Castile on Kickstarter! So far, we’ve reached an impressive 88% of our €17,500 funding goal with the help of more than 343 backers from 33 different countries. This incredible support has been truly inspiring, and we couldn’t have come this far without you.

But remember, Kickstarter operates on an all-or-nothing basis, and we need your help to reach our goal! Now is the time to rally together and make that final push.

[h2]Special Black Friday Deals[/h2]

In the spirit of Black Friday (yes, it’s a whole week now!), we’ve introduced three exclusive Black Friday deals for our campaign. These add-ons come at a reduced price and can be added to your current pledges:

[list]
[*]USB stick flash drive: Includes a copy of the game and all digital content.
[*]Second big box: Made of high-quality cardboard, printed and exclusive to Kickstarter.
[*]Resin figurine: This gorgeous 10cm (3.9'') resin figurine will be delivered in full color, 3D-printed, and hand-painted. Each one is consecutively numbered, ensuring you own an exclusive piece of art found nowhere else!

[h2][b]Exclusive Interviews and Sneak Peeks[/b][/h2]

English interview:
https://adventuregamehotspot.com/interview/3142/torrezno-entertainments-luis-izquierdo-juez-myths-monsters-and-surprising


[h2]Join Us in the Final 48 Hours![/h2]

We’re heading into a thrilling final 48 hours, so please wish us luck!

If you’d like to help make the game the best it can be—with more translations like German or French, and additional voiceovers—please make a pledge and help us reach our campaign goal and beyond.

Back us here on Kickstarter:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/torrezno/legends-of-castile-a-folk-point-and-click-adventure-game]BACK US NOW ON KICKSTARTER HERE[/url]

notes.title: 🟢 Legends of Castile just launched on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[h1]The folk point-and-click adventure game Legends of Castile just launched on Kickstarter![/h1]

🟢The folk point-and-click adventure game Legends of Castile just launched on Kickstarter! 🟢

Legends of Castile is a new comic fantasy point-and-click adventure with full HD hand-drawn graphics, and a twist: The protagonist's biggest dream is to become a nun, and she must investigate the region's folk legends to fulfill it.

We recommend you to check the rewards as soon as possible, because there will be early bird pledge levels for a limited time (early birds finish on the evening of October 31st)!

You can pledge for the campaign here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/torrezno/legends-of-castile-a-folk-point-and-click-adventure-game


Let’s take a closer look at some of the campaign rewards in more detail:

[h2]The Big box[/h2]

Being a child of the 90s, I grew up playing adventure games during the era of big, wonderful physical releases. These boxes featured gorgeous art (often much better than the game visuals) and complete manuals that explained not only how to play the game but also its lore and curiosities.

With classics like The Curse of Monkey Island, King’s Quest VII, and Grim Fandango in mind, I designed the big box for Legends of Castile. This is what I created, and I hope you like it as much as I do! You’ll find it in the campaign starting at the Big Box tier.

notes.title: Legends of Castile goes to Steam Scream 3D (and to Kickstarter)!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!🎃,

We are making a point and click adventure called Legends of Castile. It is a new comic fantasy point-and-click adventure with full HD hand-drawn graphics, and a twist: The protagonist's biggest dream is to become a nun, and she must investigate the region's folk legends to fulfill it.

Is that intriguing enough for you? Well, we have more insights about the spooky story:

The main character of this adventure is María, a young and fearless, though clumsy, Castilian girl. The story begins when, just after a long night with her friends, María has a vision of the Virgin Mary, after which she decides to become a nun. María asks to be ordained at a convent in Burgos, where her future mother superior assigns her a very important mission: To fulfill her dream, María must investigate the mythological creatures that have been appearing around the territory of Castile, and collect an item from each to prove their existence. Only once she has done this will the bishop take action against the creatures, to end their threat to the population of Castile... and Christianity.

Not sure if this could be your game yet? let us show you some features of the game:

[list]
[*] Lateral logic adventure puzzles, with a smooth difficulty curve
[*] Classic frame by frame animation
[*] An original story full of fantasy, humor and Spanish folk legends
[*] Inspired by classic adventures from the 90`s
[*] More than 30 characters and mythological creatures
[*] Around 50 picturesque hand-drawn scenes in full HD resolution
[*] Hundreds of objects to inspect, combine and use in the adventure
[*] No panel/mechanical exogenous adventure puzzles (guaranteed!)
[*] One button interface with 3 contextual verbs
[*] An Original soundtrack and music pieces of Castilian folk music
[*] Languages: If the game reaches the funding goal on Kickstarter, it will be translated in English and Spanish texts. (Voice over and More languages could be added if the game reaches certain stretch goals)
[*] Planned release on:
🖥️🖱️PC: Windows, Mac, Linux
[/list]

During Steam Scream 3D, you can play a demo of the game featuring spooky creatures like a Cyclops (Ojaranco) and familiar imp-like (called lil enemies). These mythological creatures hail from Spain. Starting now, you can experience the spooky folk creatures from Castile in a 30-minute to 1-hour demo!

If you enjoy the demo, join our 🟢Kickstarter🟢 campaign, launching tomorrow, Tuesday, October 29th! Visit the pre-launch page now and tap "Notify me on launch" so you get notified when it starts. There will be early bird rewards, and you wouldn’t want to miss them!

Here's the link: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/torrezno/legends-of-castile-a-folk-point-and-click-adventure-game

We need your support to bring Legends of Castile to life! Your involvement is crucial to our success, and we can’t do it without you.

What there will be in the Kickstarter?

Embark on an epic journey through the mystical lands of Castile. To make this campaign special, we have incredible physical rewards for our backers:

[list]
[*] Big Box Full of Goodies: A beautifully designed box packed with exclusive items and surprises.
[*] Printed Manual + Bestiary: A comprehensive guide showing all the features and legends of the game, meticulously explained and illustrated.
[*] Figurine of María de Salazar: A stunning collectible figurine of one of the game’s most iconic characters.
[*] Printed Map of the game: Don’t get lost when travelling around Castile!
[/list]


Have a great spooky week!🎃🎃🎃

Luis from Torrezno Entertainment

notes.title: Exclusive in game inventory item for newsletter subscribers!
notes.notes:
Prepare yourself for Legends of Castile adventure game and get an exclusive inventory item in the game!


[h1]What is Legends of Castile?[/h1]

Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl (María de Salazar) who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.


[h1]What awaits you as a member?[/h1]

Immediate Reward: Sign up now and you will get an exclusive object in María's inventory!.
Artistic Introductions & Lore: Be the first to discover new art of the game and insights from the development.
Early Access Testing: You will be invited to our Discord community member, where you’ll have the unique opportunity to test early versions of the game.
Monthly Digests: Our updates are a curated selection of meaningful developments in the game, ensuring you’re informed without the clutter of spam.

[h1]Crowdfunding with Kickstarter soon[/h1]

We will tell you in with a newsletter when the campaign starts, it will be very soon! Be sure to sign up!
 

Don’t miss out on this epic tale set against the backdrop of historic Spain. Sign up to our newsletter now and become a part of María’s legendary journey!

"Legends of Castile" will be featured as one of the game demos at the Adventure Game Hotspot Fan Fair this weekend, even though we can't physically be in Tacoma, USA.

Here's the event page on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45081188-Adventure-Game-Fan-Fair/sale/adventuregamefanfair2024

Therefore, we've just released a new version of the game demo with significant improvements in the game menu and gameplay.
 
We encourage users to try it out and provide us with their feedback, as adding the game to their Steam wishlist is very important.
 
The "Legends of Castile" demo version 3.0.0 is now available on Steam.

What is Legends of Castile game about?

Legends of Castile is a fantasy and comedy point and click adventure set in Spain in the 19th century, in the region known as Castile. It's the story of a village girl who has to investigate the myths and legends of Castile in order to fulfill a very particular dream, to become a nun. You will be able to advance in the story by solving puzzles and riddles integrated with it, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures using your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.
 
 
Who is the protagonist of this story?

The main character of this adventure is María, a young, fearless, though clumsy Castilian girl. The story begins when just after a long night with her friends, she has a vision of the Virgin Mary, after which she decides to become a nun. Therefore, María goes to a convent in Burgos and requests to be ordained as a nun. However, in order to fulfill that dream, her future mother superior will assign her a very important mission. She will have to investigate the folk mythological creatures that have been appearing around the territory of Castile, and collect an item from each of them to prove their existence so the abbot will take action and finish with their threat to the population of Castile... and Christianity.

notes.title: Legends of Castile will be very soon on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello adventurers![/h1]

We’re announcing that there will be a Legends of Castile Kickstarter campaign very soon!
 
Kickstarter is probably the most known crowdfunding service of the world, it has been used for funding thousands of videogames, and what is more important, for similar adventure games, with great success.


[h2]Why Crowdfunding?[/h2]

Torrezno Entertainment is actually a solo developer studio with some help. I take care of most of the development by doing the script, puzzle design, art, animation, character design, programming… etc. However, there are some things that I cannot do, like music, sound design, voice over, proofreading, more translations… and these are needed so we can deliver to the players the professional and top quality adventure game that you deserve.
 
In the campaign, we’ll explain in a detailed way how the funds will be used. Therefore, either you have been following the game development or not, this could interest you, because not only you’ll be able to help the development of the game by pre-purchasing the game, but you'll also be able to get rewards, specially if you like to collect adventure game physical perks, like a big box, manual, badges, and more!

To do this, María goes to a convent in Burgos to become a nun. However, in order to fulfill this dream, her future mother superior assigns her a very important mission. María will have to investigate the mythological creatures that have been appearing around Castile, and collect an item from each of them to prove their existence so the abbot will take action and end his threat against the population of Castile... and Christianity. In Legends of Castile you can advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meet all kinds of characters, defeat mythological creatures using your wit, and explore picturesque places throughout Castile.

Not sure if this could be your game yet? let us show you some features of the game:

- Lateral logic adventure puzzles, with a smooth difficulty curve, no dead ends or deaths, just fun.
- Female main character.
- Classic frame by frame animation, with lip syncing.
- An original story full of fantasy, humor and Spanish folk legends and myths to discover.
- Not too explicit references to the adventure game classics.
- Inspired by classic adventures like Monkey Island and Broken Sword.
- More than 30 characters and mythological creatures to interact with.
- Around 50 picturesque scenes hand-drawn with paper and pencil and digitally colored in full HD resolution.
- Hundreds of objects to inspect, combine and use in the adventure.
- No panel/mechanical exogenous adventure puzzles (guaranteed!).
- One button interface with 3 contextual verbs which provides more experimentation and fun.
- An Original soundtrack and music pieces of Castilian folk music.

With all this, we hope to be able to convince you to wishlist the game, that will came out on 2024. However, we have something even better, during Steam Scream you will be able to play a demo of the game! Starting now you can play a game demo and experience the spooky folk creatures from Castile in a 30min - 1h demo!

If you try the demo, please tell us what do you think about it!, here are our social media and Discord server, so you can give us first hand feedback and even try beta versions of our game!

notes.title: Legends of Castile demo released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43687467/1ee5ecebd70482480ac366d7db6b1ecb8de2fb75.jpg[/img]

Hi mighty adventurers!

Are you ready to explore picturesque places from Spain and investigate the folk legends of Castile?

If you love adventure games like The Curse of Monkey Island or Broken Sword, this adventure game might be for you! Or it could be that you haven’t played an adventure game before, but want to experience what a folk adventure is.

Discover part of the first chapter of the adventure with Legends of Castile demo, and find out what a ‘lil enemy’ or an ‘ojaranco’ is, in a demo that establishes the game's setting, the humor, and some logical puzzles to start the adventure in a smooth way, getting you ready for the full adventure, which will arrive next year (2024).

I hope you enjoy the demo as much as I enjoyed doing it, I’ve put all my effort and my love for adventure games in it.

The demo is translated in English, Spanish and French languages, and it’s available on Windows, MAC OS and Linux platforms.

See you very soon for more thrilling news!

Luis from Torrezno Entertainment
